result.title: AutoEMatic: Runtime-Adaptive Mixed-Precision LLM Inference via Automatic Exponent-Mantissa Refinement
result.summary: Existing LLM post-training quantization techniques determine precision before inference begins, yet the precision a model requires varies dynamically across prompts, layers, and inference phases. We present AutoEMatic, a full-stack co-design that adapts the precision of weights, activations, and the KV cache at runtime. A lightweight policy selects each layer's precision at every prefill and decode step from two runtime signals: the entropy of the next-token distribution and the magnitude of each layer's update to its hidden states. This runtime adaptation is made practical by AutoFP, a multi-scale floating-point format that derives 2-, 4-, and 6-bit precisions from a single NVFP4 base format. We realize AutoEMatic on two targets: GPU kernels that execute AutoFP on NVFP4 Tensor Cores, and an accelerator whose vector MAC datapath executes all AutoFP formats natively. Across reasoning and agentic benchmarks, AutoEMatic improves accuracy by up to 21.7% over NVFP4 and matches group-scaled FP6 accuracy on most benchmarks, using 4.9 bits per weight versus 4.5 for NVFP4. On GB300 GPUs, AutoEMatic retains approximately 90-98% of NVFP4 decode throughput across the evaluated configurations. Furthermore, the AutoEMatic accelerator reduces latency by 1.6-2.3x and energy by 7-23% compared to an accelerator with NVFP4-only datapath at iso-accuracy.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AutoEMatic，在 prefill 与 decode 每步依据「下一 token 分布熵」和「各层隐藏状态更新幅度」两个运行时信号逐层选择精度，并配合 AutoFP 多尺度浮点格式，在 GPU kernel 与专用加速器上实现权重、激活和 KV cache 的运行时混合精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 把隐藏状态更新幅度与输出熵当作运行时信号来分配计算资源，可能为 LVR 中按状态变化动态分配计算、判断何时停止的成本信号提供借鉴，可供核查；但论文本身不涉及视觉推理或 latent 内容质量。
